channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Metals, cement & chemicals in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.7).

item.title: [−1] Hormuz hit by the worst attacks of the war as flows plunge; US threatens to 'hit Iran hard'
item.description:
Two more ship strikes were reported overnight. Brent settled 0.9% lower at $105.69 on Monday, but analysts warn a closure could lift oil to $130. Escalating.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Crude-linked inputs

Why it matters: A full closure would sharply lift crude, LNG and freight costs for India, widening the import bill and pushing inflation and the rupee further.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Wholesale inflation due today; forecast to cross 10% in September from 9.92%
item.description:
A domestic research economist expects 10.2%, as the West Asia crisis reversed two months of easing fuel and power inflation. Follows retail inflation of 5.54%. Rising.

Metals, cement & chemicals: mild headwind (−1) — Input costs squeeze margins

Why it matters: Double-digit wholesale inflation squeezes manufacturers' margins and feeds through to retail prices, adding to the case for further RBI hikes.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −2, Bond market (G-Secs) −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
